content:
Asha: Quick check - who wants a low-lag retro LAN next Friday evening? thinking GameCube + Smash, plus a few PC roguelikes for the corner setup.
Tom: heck yes. I can bring an original GC + 2 controllers and a CRT if people want the authentic feel. :tv:
Riley: I will bring my Switch for rollback netcode games, but I'm down for couch Smash too. can anyone bring a GC->USB adapter?
Jin: I have 2 Mayflash GC adapters and a powered ethernet switch. also spare ethernet cables. i can drop by at 5pm to help setup.
Asha: awesome - real talk: if we have CRT, plug ordering matters. please bring a multi-out power strip and labeled cables.
Tom: noted. i'll label mine with blue tape. also bringing a surge protector.
Riley: poll? what's everyone's priority: 1) Smash on CRT (local) 2) Smash on Switch (online rollback) 3) Multiplayer PC roguelikes 4) Melee setups for invitational
Riley: react with :one: :two: :three: :four:
Jin: :one: and :four: from me. Melee bracket pls.
Asha: :one: for nostalgia. also can someone volunteer to record matches? quick phone angle is fine. :camera:
Tom: i'll record the final bracket on my phone and upload to #random-vids.
Jin: setup notes (quick): ```
- Venue: 6th floor lounge
- Bring: GC + controllers, GC->USB adapters, CRT or RCA->HDMI capture if needed
- Network: Jin brings switch and cables
- Time: 6pm setup, 7pm games
```
Riley: cc @Asha can we pin the notes and maybe reserve a couch space? want to avoid surprise meetings in the lounge.
Asha: pinged facilities, they said it's fine as long as it's under 10 people. i'll pin the notes and post a sign.
Tom: last thing - if anyone has spare rumble adapters or broken controllers that need parts, bring them. we can jury-rig stuff on the spot.
Jin: bringing a small toolkit. :wrench:
Asha: perfect. see you all Friday! I'll post a final RSVP thread tomorrow. :party:
